ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram of the food web shown, what does the piscivorous fish consume?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the upper left of the food web diagram there is a label “Piscivorous fish”, and directly below it there is a label “Planktivorous fish”. Between the two there is an arrow pointing from the lower planktivorous fish to the upper piscivorous fish. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate that energy flows from the organism being eaten to the consumer, so the arrow from planktivorous fish to piscivorous fish indicates that piscivorous fish consume planktivorous fish.
